name: Skeleton
description: A placeholder shape while content loads (a text line, a box or a circle) on the section surface, pulsing softly; still under Reduce Motion. Shapes only: no data or list logic.
usage: Use while a list or grid loads, drawn in the layout the content will take, so the page doesn't jump when it arrives
line for a heading or a line of text (set width and height to the text's), block for a photo or card (size it with height or an aspect class), circle for an avatar
Wrap the shapes in one SkeletonGroup naming what loads ("Loading photos"), and replace the group with the content when it arrives
The shapes take className and style for layout (a grid cell, aspect-square); their surface, corners and pulse are the component's
For a wait with no layout to stand in for (a button's action, a whole page), use Loader
examples: // a row with an avatar and two lines
design: Sizes: line 100% wide and 1em tall unless set; block 100% wide, its height the caller's; circle 2.5rem unless set, height following width. Numbers are px

Pulse: opacity 1 → 0.5 → 1 every 2s, forever, on ease.springOut (the portfolio explorer's 2s pulse; a continuous indicator, so outside the motion size scale). Every shape mounted together pulses together
Reduce Motion: no pulse, full opacity
accessibility: Every shape is aria-hidden: an empty box means nothing read aloud

SkeletonGroup carries the one thing a screen reader hears: a visually hidden role="status" line, its label ("Loading" by default), so a reader who reaches the region hears what is loading instead of nothing

No aria-busy: most screen readers say nothing for it, an aria-busy ancestor can hold a live region's announcement back, and the group is replaced rather than un-busied when the content arrives. Announcing the arrival ("24 photos") is the page's, in its own live region

props.name: shape
props.description: line: a text line. block: a box (photo, card). circle: an avatar.

props.name: width
props.description: px when a number, else any CSS length. Defaults: 100% (line, block), 2.5rem (circle).

props.name: height
props.description: px when a number, else any CSS length. Defaults: 1em (line), none (block: size it or give it an aspect class), the width (circle).

props.name: className
props.description: Layout classes added to the shape's own (aspect-square, a grid placement).

subcomponents.name: SkeletonGroup
subcomponents.description: The loading region: a div around the shapes (className for their layout) with a visually hidden role="status" line naming what loads.

props.name: label
props.description: What is loading, read by screen readers in place of the shapes.

props.name: children
props.description: The shapes, in the layout the content will take.
